words.gloss: those who are of the mere measure

literal: Except for the mere measure of being called those who exist, unlearned people are like barren land that yields nothing.
translation: Except for the mere fact that they are said to exist, those who are unlearned are like barren, useless land.
modern: உயிரோடு இருக்கிறார்கள் என்று சொல்லும் அளவினரே அல்லாமல், கல்லாதவர்கள் ஒன்றும் விளையாத களர் நிலத்திற்கு ஒப்பாவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet compares unlearned people to barren, saline soil (களர்) which cannot produce any useful crops. The author states that the uneducated are like this useless land, serving no productive purpose for society. The phrase 'உளரென்னும் மாத்திரையர்' emphasizes that their only attribute is that they are physically alive, and nothing more. They lack the intellectual and moral fruitfulness that comes with learning.
